title: pleno-dlp crash report
description: Wire contract between the pleno-dlp client (pkg/telemetry/crash) and the plenoai.com crash relay (workers/crash-relay). This file is the single source of truth: the Go Report struct and the relay's validate() are both asserted against its property allowlist by tests on either side.

schema.description: Contract identifier. The relay rejects any other value.

report_id.description: Random per-report identifier used only to correlate relay logs with client logs.

timestamp.description: When the crash was captured, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 in UTC.

commit.description: pleno-dlp build commit (GoReleaser main.commit); omitted when unknown.

go_version.description: Go runtime version that produced the report (runtime.Version()).

command.description: Top-level subcommand that panicked, e.g. scan or revoke.

error_type.description: Panic value's Go type, or "error" for a handled fatal error.

error_message.description: Redacted panic message. Scanned file content and secrets MUST NOT appear here; the relay rejects any key outside this allowlist so a client cannot smuggle them in.

stack_trace.description: Redacted goroutine stack. Optional; omitted when unavailable.

install_id.description: Stable, non-reversible installation identifier for deduplication. Optional; omitted when telemetry is disabled.
